description: A man in a long dark robe, short dark hair, in profile, pins a blank white sheet of paper to a stone pillar in a vaulted stone arcade. Behind him at left is a wooden screw printing press. Through an arch, Gothic tracery windows and spires of a church are visible. Dark, painterly oil style, warm candlelit tones; the painting fills the frame edge to edge with no border. No legible text.
